verdict.rationale: Docs describe visual/inline diff review (VS Code, IDE plugins), automatic PR code review, CI-integrated review/triage via GitHub Actions/GitLab CI, and hooks to run lint/tests before commits — directly matching the inspect-diffs-and-run-checks-before-merge story. Community comment corroborates Claude's reviewer capability being strong relative to implementation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the diff-review UI and pre-merge check workflow, and more detail on test-running mechanics.
